In addition to releasing the first public betas of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple has also simultaneously launched updated developer beta builds. Details are as follows.

Updated Build Arrives Alongside Public Beta

Alongside the first public beta, Apple also released updated developer beta builds for iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, marking the third round of updates.

The updated iPadOS 27 developer beta 3 carries build number 24A5380l, while the updated macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 3 carries build number 26A5378n.

It remains unclear why Apple has released updated builds, as there were no widespread reports of serious issues with the earlier versions. The changes may be aimed at fixing problems discovered before today's public beta rollout, but Apple has not provided any details.

That said, we are examining the new builds closely and will report back any noteworthy findings.

Have you discovered any new features in the updated builds? Let us know in the comments.
